// diagnostic

E0171

`{name}` is a `Dyn` method, not a field

What

`{name}` is a `Dyn` method, not a field

Why

Dyn member names are reserved for methods

Fix

Use indexing, for example `d["{name}"]`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0171: tests/ui/dyn_member_as_field.stderr.

    |
  4 |     row.len = 3
    |         ^^^
 Why: Dyn member names are reserved for methods
 Fix: Use indexing, for example `d["len"]`
